summary_1line: Bhishma explains how various fasting disciplines grant merits equal to great Vedic sacrifices and lead to heavenly rewards and long celestial enjoyment.

image_candidates.scene_text: An ascetic, thin from long fasting, is carried heavenward on a radiant golden chariot drawn by swans while celestial damsels welcome him.
In heaven, a jeweled chariot resounding with bells and veena music glides through the sky surrounded by apsaras dancing.
Bhishma lying on his bed of arrows instructs Yudhishthira about the spiritual power of fasting and simple discipline.
